speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: The cough has been with me for about two months now, and the shortness of breath definitely gets worse when I try to do physical activities. I've also noticed some mild swelling in both of my ankles over the last week, but I haven't had any fever or lost weight. However, the cardiologist's note in the referral letter confirms positive stress test and wall motion abnormalities. Please treat these findings as confirmed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction (HFpEF) or Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction (HFrEF), likely exacerbated by underlying coronary artery disease.

REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram to assess ejection fraction and wall motion abnormalities.
